He wants to beat last week's total of 324.  
First, add up the jumping jacks he has done so far this week:  
Sunday: 34  
Monday: 20  
Tuesday: 0 (skipped)  
Wednesday: 123  
Thursday: 64  
Friday: 23  

Sum = 34 + 20 = 54  
54 + 123 = 177  
177 + 64 = 241  
241 + 23 = 264  

He has done 264 so far.  
To beat 324, he needs at least 325 total.  
325 - 264 = 61.  

So he must do at least 61 on Saturday.  

Final answer: 61
